days.title: Tradate Science and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Osservatorio astronomico di Tradate FOAM13
stops.detail: Inside the park, there is also the site of community interest and special conservation zone "Pineta pedemontana di Appiano Gentile" (code SIC: IT2020007), managed by the park authority, and the FOAM13 astronomical observatory of Tradate.

stops.name: Centro Didattico Scientifico
stops.detail: The Scientific Didactic Center is linked to the FOAM13 astronomical observatory of Tradate and was established to encourage children of all ages toward the development of scientific knowledge and awareness, and to understand and preserve the nature of the park.

stops.name: roccolo di Montechiaro
stops.detail: In Tradate, the Montechiaro bird-snare was positioned north of the town on the slopes of a forest.

stops.name: Pinetina
stops.detail: There are also farmhouses and agricultural companies, some residential areas built in the last century, and the locality known as "Pinetina," home to the Angelo Moratti Sports Center, the training ground for the Inter football team, and the course of the La Pinetina Golf Club.

stops.name: Parco della Villa Caproni di Taliedo
stops.detail: Inside the Park of Villa Caproni di Taliedo in Venegono Superiore, there is a colonnade of hornbeams and a masonry lodge.
